# Orthopedics Treatment Cost in India for Patients from Nigeria

**In short:** India offers Nigerian patients high-quality orthopedic surgery—like knee and hip replacements—at a fraction of Western prices, with short waiting times and dedicated support at every step.

## Why patients from Nigeria choose India

- **Significant cost savings:** Orthopedic procedures in India cost dramatically less than in the US or UK, often saving you tens of thousands of dollars even after factoring in travel.
- **Accredited hospitals:** We connect you with internationally recognized JCI and NABH accredited hospitals that maintain high standards of clinical care.
- **Shorter waiting times:** Avoid long queues. Once your medical records are reviewed, surgery dates are typically scheduled quickly so you can return to your normal life sooner.
- **English-speaking medical teams:** Clear communication makes your treatment journey smoother and less stressful for you and your family.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it safe to have orthopedic surgery in India?**
Yes. We connect you with carefully vetted, accredited hospitals that utilize advanced surgical technology and strict infection control protocols.

All hospital bills are paid directly by you to the hospital. We do not handle your medical funds; our role is simply to facilitate your journey and communication.
